purpose: Preserve the accepted M3-C-J evaluator-authorization pin as an immutable prerequisite for the private-device operator preflight and later one-time execution.
non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
reporting-only reuse of this exact evidence
creation of a descendant operator-preflight or operator-pin branch containing the merge SHA
invalidators: artifact loss, corruption, expiry without retained immutable copy, or SHA-256 mismatch
change to the exact window packet, evaluator implementation, reviewed writer packet, database path digest, storage policy, or window bound
change to the validation workflow or pinned compatibility dependency
single_use_rule: A later private-device execution must refuse any existing reviewed database file, SQLite sidecar, operator journal, private bundle, public review, backup directory, or restore directory. Chat/session changes never authorize a rerun.
new_tree_rule: The operator preflight and later exact operator pin each receive validation only for their own changed tree. PR #229 evidence remains reused and immutable.
next_chat_rule: Read this pin and the M3-C-I/J reuse records before scheduling validation or operator work. Do not rerun accepted CI, phone witness, retained sequence, or private-device execution merely because the chat or session changed.
